name: Cart Drawer
description: A slide-over cart with drawn thumbnails, quantity steppers, remove-with-undo, an animated free-shipping bar and an upsell. Turns into a bottom sheet on phones.

props.name: items
props.description: Line items: id, name, variant, price, qty, art (notebook | mug | socks | pencil) and colour for the drawn thumbnail.

props.name: upsell
props.description: One suggested add-on shown under the items. Pass null to hide.

props.name: freeShippingThreshold
props.description: Subtotal that unlocks free shipping. Drives the progress bar.

props.name: currency / locale
props.description: Passed to Intl.NumberFormat for every price.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled open state. The built-in trigger button always reopens it.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: Called with the live items when Checkout is pressed.

props.name: strategy
props.description: Cover the viewport, or stay inside the nearest positioned parent (as in the demo).

props.name: undoSeconds
props.description: How long a removed item can be restored.
